title: Raster tray icons for Flatpak apps that only exist in the Flatpak app bundle aren't displayed
line: Tray icons of Flatpak apps like Steam that ship their own icon files now show up instead of an empty space.
explanation: Flatpak apps such as Steam send an IconThemePath like ~/.local/share/Steam/public, or a path under /app, which only exists inside their sandbox. The system tray handed that path to its icon loader as-is, so the icon was never found and the item stayed empty. The sender's D-Bus peer is usually the sandbox's xdg-dbus-proxy rather than the app, so its /proc root has no app files either. When a Flatpak sender's path is missing on the host, the tray now reads it through /proc/<pid>/root of the app's own sandbox process, taken from the instance's bwrapinfo.json (child-pid), falling back to the bus peer's pid if that file is missing.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: find icon theme paths inside Flatpak sandboxes

Flatpak apps such as Steam send an IconThemePath that only exists inside
their sandbox, so their tray icon was empty. If the path is missing on
the host, look it up through the root of the app's own sandbox process.

BUG: 442153

media.caption: Flatpak-like app behind xdg-dbus-proxy with two tray items whose icons exist only in its sandbox (~/.local/share and /app): nothing in the panel or the expanded tray
Same app with the fix: both icons (red from ~/.local/share, blue from /app) show in the panel
